title: Segmented control with equal buttons
summary: flex: 1 on each button shares the row equally, so the segments line up whatever their labels.
explanation: Each segment has flex: 1, so the row is shared out equally between them. Without it each button would be only as wide as its label, and the segments would be uneven.
flex: 1 is shorthand for flex: 1 1 0. The basis of 0 means the free space is split evenly, so a long label does not make its button wider than the others.
tryThis: Remove flex: 1 from .seg: the buttons shrink to their labels and the control looks ragged.
Give the middle segment flex: 2: it becomes twice as wide as the others.
Add a fourth segment with a longer label and watch the others shrink to match.
